This indicates a chain of interactions where Ponatinib may indirectly modulate Cyp3a5 activity via the metabolic pathway involving Nelfinavir. The presence of an enzyme inhibitor in the lowest common ancestor of Ponatinib and Nelfinavir supports this mechanism, suggesting that Ponatinib may exert a pharmacological effect on Cyp3a5 through a pathway that involves Nelfinavir. The final score of 0.3862 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, which is consistent with the presence of a direct binding interaction between Nelfinavir and Cyp3a5. The evidence is supported by a clear, albeit indirect, mechanistic pathway that links Ponatinib to Cyp3a5 through Nelfinavir.
